independent_audit.scope: Finite synthetic diagnostic; one observation per color/condition/CFA. Native-panel rerendering uses the common production display; scalar metric arithmetic is independently NumPy64. This audit does not claim visual review, quality promotion or a training cause.

manual_visual_review.finding: Neutral fields visually agree at3k/10k. The warm10k field becomes visibly darker/browner than exact analytic GT. Zeroing the camera-feature input slice largely repairs this warm field. Uniform targets test color fidelity, not detail recovery or broad real quality.

limitations: One training trajectory, four chosen colors, two conditions and four CFAs, one observation per condition/CFA. ADC copies are not independent noise draws. No causal training diagnosis, universal correction, full-photo score or real-camera superiority claim. Earlier V46 has a real-primary tradeoff; production and running V58 remain unchanged.
